eventName: 6th Annual One Lakh Palm Seeds Plantation Festival! 9th Phase Plantation Drive
eventDescription:
Vidhaigal Organization, in association with the Forest Department and Golden Hearts Lions Club, successfully organized a plantation drive today along the banks of the Cheyyar River at Thirumukkoodal, where 20,000 palm seeds were planted.
Participants:
? Students of Rasi College
? Students of St. Mary's College of Allied Health Sciences
? Students of SRM College
? Teachers of Triveni Academy
? Annachathiram Team
? Volunteers
Planting palm seeds is not merely about sowing seeds in the soil; it is about creating a greener and more sustainable future for generations to come!
